content_blocks.text: The Procurement Act 2023 brings wide ranging new transparency requirements with which Authorities will need to comply; with new notices relating to each stage of the procurement needing to be published to the Central Digital Platform.
heading_path: Confused by all the new Notices under the Act?

content_blocks.text: Our Notices Generator is here to help you work out which notices you will need for your competitive tendering process, direct award or framework call-off under the Act.

content_blocks.text: Disclaimer: This Notices Generator is intended for information only; it is not a substitute for legal advice in relation to transparency obligations related to a specific procurement/contract. Every effort has been made to ensure that results provided by the Notices Generator accurately reflect the position under the Act. By using it, you accept and agree that such use (and any use made of the results) is subject to our t erms and conditions, which include a disclaimer and exclusion of liability. Note that any failure to comply with transparency obligations under the Act may have serious legal consequences for a contracting authority. If you are at all unsure, we recommend that you seek specific legal advice.
